announcements.title: Development Resumed — 1.0.59
announcements.message:
NanaPlay is back! Version 1.0.59 brings a big bug-fix batch: your display name no longer leaks into diagnostics, the Indonesian language option actually works now, local music playlists survive app restarts, stream reconnects are more reliable, and music keeps playing in the background with lock-screen controls. Update from the Settings page. Happy gaming!

NanaPlay kembali! Versi 1.0.59 membawa banyak perbaikan bug: nama tampilan tidak lagi bocor ke diagnostics, opsi Bahasa Indonesia sekarang benar-benar berfungsi, playlist musik lokal tidak hilang saat aplikasi dibuka ulang, reconnect stream lebih andal, dan musik tetap jalan di background dengan kontrol lock-screen. Update dari halaman Settings. Selamat bermain!

announcements.title: A Note on Updates
announcements.message:
A quick note from Papah: NanaPlay updates have been less frequent lately — mainly because bug reports and suggestions from users have also been rare, and I am currently busy building a brand-new app project as well. But do not worry: NanaPlay will keep receiving updates whenever there are fixes, reports, or suggestions from you. Sorry for the long wait, and thank you for sticking around!

Catatan singkat dari Papah: update NanaPlay belakangan ini memang agak jarang — terutama karena laporan bug dan masukan dari kalian juga jarang masuk, dan aku lagi sibuk bikin project aplikasi baru juga. Tapi tenang: NanaPlay akan tetap di-update setiap ada perbaikan, laporan, ataupun saran dari kalian. Mohon maaf jika kalian lama menunggu update, dan terima kasih sudah setia!

announcements.title: About the Recent Stream Issues
announcements.message:
Having trouble starting a stream since October 27 — stuck queue, 'Server not responding', or no video even after signaling connects? That is a server-side GeForce NOW issue affecting third-party clients like NanaPlay (and OpenNOW), not a bug in NanaPlay itself. Community reports say the official GFN app still works for some users, so it can be a temporary alternative. Please do not rapidly switch regions hoping for a fix — it does not help and just puts you back in another queue. If a stream fails, end it normally and try again later. And unlike some other clients: bug reports are welcome here — if NanaPlay itself misbehaves, use Settings → Share diagnostics and send the link to Papah.

Lagi susah mulai stream sejak 27 Oktober — antrean stuck, 'Server tidak merespons', atau video tidak muncul padahal signaling sudah tersambung? Itu gangguan di sisi server GeForce NOW yang kena klien pihak ketiga seperti NanaPlay (dan OpenNOW), bukan bug NanaPlay sendiri. Laporan komunitas: aplikasi GFN resmi masih jalan untuk sebagian user, jadi bisa jadi alternatif sementara. Jangan pindah-pindah region terus — tidak membantu, cuma bikin kamu antre ulang. Kalau stream gagal, akhiri stream seperti biasa lalu coba lagi nanti. Dan beda dengan klien lain: laporan bug tetap diterima di sini — kalau NanaPlay sendiri yang bermasalah, pakai Settings → Share diagnostics lalu kirim link-nya ke Papah.

announcements.title: We're Back — 1.0.105
announcements.message:
NanaPlay is back with an update! Version 1.0.105 fixes the queue retry racing the session stop, which could drop a retry straight back into the 'Active session found' dialog. Sorry for the long wait — Papah has been busy building another side project. Update from the Settings page. Happy gaming!

NanaPlay kembali dengan update! Versi 1.0.105 memperbaiki retry antrean yang balapan dengan stop sesi, yang bisa menjatuhkan retry kembali ke dialog 'Active session found'. Mohon maaf sudah lama menunggu — Papah lagi sibuk ngerjain project gabut lain. Update dari halaman Settings. Selamat bermain!

announcements.title: 1.0.106 — Video-Offer Fixes
announcements.message:
NanaPlay 1.0.106 is out! This update adds one-per-session launch identity diagnostics to help trace 'Server not responding' incidents, retries your selected video profile on the first video-offer timeout before falling back to safe H264, and sends the right launch-mode headers for touch-friendly games. Update from the Settings page. Happy gaming!

NanaPlay 1.0.106 sudah rilis! Update ini menambahkan diagnostics identitas launch satu baris per sesi untuk melacak insiden 'Server tidak merespons', mencoba ulang profil video yang dipilih pada video-offer timeout pertama sebelum fallback ke H264 yang aman, dan mengirim header launch mode yang tepat untuk game touch-friendly. Update dari halaman Settings. Selamat bermain!
